title: Bora Employer Pipeline Application Question Evaluation
description: Derived analysis of one ApplicationQuestion against a specific Evidence Repository state. This is deterministic derived analysis, not source truth: it must remain fully separate from and must never cause mutation of the immutable ApplicationQuestion record it evaluates. Re-running evaluation against a later Evidence Repository state produces a new evaluation record with the same application_question_id and a different evidence_version.

application_question_evaluation_id.description: Permanent unique identifier for this evaluation event.

application_question_id.description: ApplicationQuestion this evaluation was computed for.

evidence_version.description: SHA-256 content digest of the trusted Evidence index used for this evaluation, mirroring the existing résumé validation-digest convention (src/resume_digest.py). Not a new global versioning subsystem; scoped to this evaluation only.

result.description: Same result vocabulary as evidence_match.schema.json, reused for consistency; scoped to one ApplicationQuestion clause rather than a JD Requirement.

clause_evaluations.description: Per-clause evidence-support results. Empty array when the question has no clauses to evaluate.

support_state.description: Aggregate evidence-support description across clause_evaluations. Deliberately not YES/NO: this describes evidence support, not a candidate truth assertion.

predicate_result.description: Deterministic three-valued evaluation of logic_expression over clause_evaluations. NOT_APPLICABLE for questions with no safe deterministic predicate (free text, no clauses, ambiguous multi-clause question with no logic_expression, or an unsupported question_type).

safe_boolean_answer.description: Deterministic derivation for YES_NO questions only; NOT_APPLICABLE for every other question_type. Must never be machine-finalized when answer_policy is ALWAYS_HUMAN -- forced to NOT_APPLICABLE in that case regardless of predicate_result.

manual_review_required.description: True whenever predicate_result is UNCERTAIN or NOT_APPLICABLE, or when answer_policy forces human finalization.

notes.description: Optional clarifications. Null when no note is needed.
